newsitem.title: UK: Santander Investment expands London operation.
newsitem.headline: Santander Investment expands London operation.

text.p: Santander Investment said on Wednesday it was expanding its capital markets unit in London to cover eastern and southern Europe equity and fixed income business, and also fixed income for Africa and the Middle East.
The office formerly focused on the Latin American equity market.

"Santander's London operations will be integrated with the capital markets business currently being conducted out of New York in order to bolster Santander's regional strength in sales, trading and research," the company said in a statement.

As part of the changes, Jose Manuel Arrojo, chief executive officer of Santander Investment's brokerage house in Spain will become managing director, equity sales, trading and research for Europe. Juan San Roman, currently head of equity research in Spain will become head of equity research for Europe.
Francis Coles, formerly of ING Barings (U.S.) Securities will become managing director, equity capital markets for Europe.
In fixed income, Mario Toros from Santander's Brazilian office, will now lead the local currency proprietary trading desk, and Stanislav Kovtou, formerly of ICFI in Moscow will also join this area.
Anne Louise Gibbins, from ING Barings has joined fixed income sales for emerging markets. Additional Santander staff will be transferred to London to strengthen the fixed income area.
